meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's start with who decided Owen gets a zero, and why I found out after he saw it on his phone in the middle of class.
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what, Hale? You haven't shown me a single thing, and if Owen sits a rewrite now, that's an admission he never made. What's your evidence?
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
Generous. I'm not most parents, Hale, and I'm still waiting to hear what Owen supposedly did.
Will you take it or not?
No. Show me what you have, or withdraw the zero and I'll take this to the principal anyway.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone contacted me, and that you show me whatever evidence you believe you have. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see your evidence, and she plans to go to the principal. The fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but she couldn't accept it because no evidence was ever put in front of her.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed no dated, checkable evidence tied to Owen's work.
What cost ground: Offering the rewrite before showing anything, then calling it generous and pushing for a yes or no, because accepting would have meant admitting something that had never been shown.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your side of the meeting never came anywhere near that night, since you presented no evidence at all. It proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your very first turn, take ownership in one sentence that the zero went in before her family was contacted, which breaks procedure 4.2, then show her one dated document from Owen's own work that she can check herself before you mention a rewrite.
